I can’t reliably evaluate this many state changes by hand. This script will compute the final values directly from the assignment block: paste the full text into standard input, then send EOF.

```python
import re
import sys

state = {}
text = sys.stdin.read()

for name, value in re.findall(r'\b([A-Za-z]+)\s*<-\s*(-?\d+|[A-Za-z]+)\s*;', text):
    state[name] = int(value) if re.fullmatch(r'-?\d+', value) else state[value]

names = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP"]
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {state[name]}" for name in names))
```
